## Professional Memberships

**Institute of Applied Statistics, Sri Lanka (IASSL)** — Life Member

- Member, Research and Development Committee (2025–2026)  
  - Contributed to ongoing applied research initiatives, including the development of a rugby ranking system for Sri Lankan rugby.

- Member, Statistical Popularization Committee (2025–2026)  
  Contributed to national-level statistical outreach and education activities, including:
  - Stat Retreat, Sri Lanka’s first residential camp for undergraduate students in statistics
  - Delivery of educational seminars for G.C.E. Advanced Level students across Sri Lanka, promoting statistical thinking and awareness of higher education opportunities
  - Organization and support of the Statistics Olympiad 2026
  
  
## Workshops & Training Activities

- Conducted interdisciplinary research workshops in collaboration with **Whyteleafe Performing Arts Academy**, supporting the integration of data literacy within creative education contexts for school students.

- Delivered SPSS training workshops for BSc (Hons) Applied Science students, Faculty of Applied Sciences, University of Sri Jayewardenepura, focusing on applied statistical analysis and software-based data interpretation.

- Conducted webinars for students in the Department of Statistics, University of Sri Jayewardenepura, highlighting higher education opportunities and academic pathways in statistics.
